name: cache-warmer
description: Keep the main conversation's prompt cache warm by automatically forking its last request, tools denied and billed like any request, shortly before the cache expires; switch its lifetime between 5m and 1h, and show each refresh's cost and estimated saving.

ttl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
ttl.description: Main-conversation cache lifetime this mod sets; refreshes run at 90% of it. 1h writes cost 2x input instead of 1.25x.

idle5m.title: Idle refreshes, 5m
idle5m.description: Refreshes a 5-minute cache gets while the session is idle, 0 to 20; each still needs the $0.05 expected saving.

idle1h.title: Idle refreshes, 1h
idle1h.description: Refreshes a 1-hour cache gets while the session is idle, 0 to 20; each still needs the $0.05 expected saving.

band.title: Refresh band
band.description: Show a one-line band above the prompt while a refresh runs and for 5 seconds after it.
